moments.title: Halloween Weekend Across the UK
moments.blurb: Halloween is celebrated across the UK on Saturday, October 31st, with many themed events and parties running throughout the weekend.

angles.name: Spooky Saturday
angles.copy: It's Halloween tomorrow! Are your pumpkins carved and costumes ready for a frightfully fun Saturday night?

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: Pumpkin patches, spooky trails, and trick-or-treating – how are you celebrating Halloween with the family this year? Many events are on all weekend!

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaches
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night, also known as Bonfire Night, is celebrated annually on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays scheduled across the UK throughout the surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is just around the corner! Where are you heading for your fireworks fix this year? Big displays are planned for the 5th and surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Local Displays
angles.copy: Get ready for rockets and sparklers! Bonfire Night is next Thursday, but many local displays will be lighting up the skies this weekend and next. Check local listings for details.

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: A busy Premier League weekend features Chelsea vs Man Utd and Man City vs Brighton on Saturday, followed by a huge Liverpool vs Arsenal clash on Sunday.

angles.name: Saturday Showdowns
angles.copy: Premier League action is ON! Chelsea host Man Utd at 5:30pm, while Man City take on Brighton. Who are you backing today?

angles.name: Sunday Blockbuster
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive Sunday! Liverpool face Arsenal at Anfield. Will the Gunners keep their title push going or can the Reds claim all three points?

moments.title: Champions League Matchday 4
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League returns next week for Matchday 4, with UK teams in action including Aston Villa vs Barcelona and Man Utd vs Roma on Tuesday, and Arsenal vs SK Slavia Praha and Man City vs RB Leipzig on Wednesday.

angles.name: European Nights
angles.copy: Champions League is back! Tuesday sees Aston Villa take on Barcelona and Man Utd face Roma. Huge tests for the English sides!

angles.name: Midweek Clashes
angles.copy: Who will dominate in Europe? Arsenal and Man City are both in Champions League action next Wednesday. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Autumn Nations Championship Begins
moments.blurb: The inaugural Autumn Nations Championship kicks off next week, with Ireland vs Argentina on Nov 6, Scotland vs New Zealand and Wales vs Japan on Nov 7, and England vs Australia on Nov 8.

angles.name: England's Opener
angles.copy: England kick off their Autumn Nations Championship campaign against Australia at Twickenham on Sunday, Nov 8th. Get ready for some thrilling rugby!

angles.name: Wales & Scotland Home Games
angles.copy: Wales host Japan in Cardiff and Scotland face New Zealand in Edinburgh next Saturday, Nov 7th, as the Autumn Nations Championship gets underway. Huge games for the home nations!

moments.title: England Men's Rugby League World Cup Exit
moments.blurb: England men's rugby league team faces an early exit from the Rugby League World Cup 2026, marking a defining moment for the sport in the country.

angles.name: World Cup Disappointment
angles.copy: Tough news for England fans as the men's rugby league team faces an early World Cup exit. What do you think this means for the future of the sport?

angles.name: Rugby League Reaction
angles.copy: The rugby league world is reacting to England's early World Cup departure. Share your thoughts on the team's performance.

moments.title: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' Tops UK Chart
moments.blurb: Welsh singer Jamie Miller earned his first UK number-one single with 'Babydoll' on the chart dated October 23, 2026, becoming the first Welsh artist to do so in 15 years.

angles.name: Welsh Chart Topper
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Welsh singer Jamie Miller! His track 'Babydoll' hit #1 last week, making him the first Welsh artist to top the charts in 15 years!

angles.name: New No.1 Success
angles.copy: Still buzzing about Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' hitting the top spot! What a massive achievement for the Welsh star. Have you streamed it today?

moments.title: Welsh Drummer Chris Slade is 80
moments.blurb: Welsh drummer Chris Slade, known for his work with AC/DC, Uriah Heep, and Manfred Mann's Earth Band, celebrates his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Welsh Rock Drummer
angles.copy: Happy 80th birthday to Welsh rock legend Chris Slade! From AC/DC to Uriah Heep, his drumming has powered some massive bands. What's your favourite track he played on?

angles.name: ACDC Drummer's Milestone
angles.copy: Celebrating Welsh powerhouse drummer Chris Slade on his 80th birthday! A true force behind the kit for decades. Give him some love!
